news.headline: uniQure (NASDAQ:QURE) Price Target Raised to $75.00 at Wells Fargo & Company
news.summary: Wells Fargo raised its price target on uniQure from $60 to $75 while maintaining an Overweight rating, following the company's Q2 2026 results and continued confidence in the AMT-130 accelerated-approval pathway.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Company Update
news.summary: uniQure reported Q2 2026 revenue of $5.8M (up 11% year-over-year and above consensus) and a wider net loss of $1.22/share, while confirming $810.3M in cash expected to fund operations into 2030. The company reaffirmed that US and UK regulatory submissions for AMT-130 remain on track for Q3 2026 and said topline four-year Phase I/II data on AMT-130 is expected in September 2026; shares rose about 5% on the update.

news.headline: uniQure CEO exercises options, sells 21,082 shares
news.summary: CEO Matthew Kapusta exercised options on 21,082 shares at $19.39 and sold them at roughly $44-$46 under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan, part of a broader wave of insider stock sales by uniQure directors and executives following the stock's post-FDA-news rally.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Closing of Upsized Public Offering and Full Exercise by Underwriters of Option to Purchase Additional Shares
news.summary: uniQure closed an upsized public offering of 5,686,813 ordinary shares at $45.50 each, including full exercise of the underwriters' overallotment option, raising aggregate gross proceeds of $259 million to fund AMT-130 commercialization readiness and the planned confirmatory study.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Preliminary Data on the First Cohort in the Phase I/IIa Clinical Trial of AMT-260 in Refractory Mesial Temporal Lobe Epilepsy
news.summary: uniQure reported that three of six patients in the first low-dose cohort of its AMT-260 gene therapy trial for refractory epilepsy saw disabling-seizure reductions of 79%-100% at months four to six, with a favorable safety profile and no related serious adverse events; the company expects updated results from the study in the first half of 2027.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Plan for BLA Submission for AMT-130 in Huntington's Disease
news.summary: Following a Type B meeting, the FDA communicated that 3-year Phase I/II data on AMT-130 would be acceptable as the primary basis for a Biologics License Application seeking accelerated approval in Huntington's disease, with the FDA also open to a non-sham, standard-of-care-controlled confirmatory study. uniQure said it plans to file the BLA in Q3 2026, and the stock surged sharply on the reversal in FDA stance.

catalysts.label: US FDA BLA submission for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to submit a Biologics License Application under the accelerated approval pathway for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease, using 3-year Phase I/II data, following FDA alignment reached in June 2026, and intends to request priority review.

catalysts.label: UK MHRA marketing authorization application (MAA) for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to submit a Marketing Authorization Application to the UK's MHRA for AMT-130, following a successful pre-submission meeting earlier in 2026.

catalysts.label: Topline 4-year Phase I/II data readout for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to release topline four-year follow-up data from the pivotal Phase I/II study of AMT-130 in Huntington's disease, which management flagged during the Q2 2026 earnings call as an upcoming near-term catalyst.

catalysts.label: Completion of second dose-cohort enrollment for AMT-260
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to complete enrollment of the second dose cohort in the Phase I/IIa study of AMT-260 for refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy, building on encouraging first-cohort seizure-reduction data reported in June 2026.

catalysts.label: Confirmatory study design alignment with FDA
catalysts.detail: uniQure is finalizing the design of the required confirmatory study (potentially standard-of-care controlled rather than sham-surgery controlled) with the FDA ahead of the BLA submission.

catalysts.label: Potential commercial launch of AMT-130
catalysts.detail: If accelerated approval is granted, uniQure intends to commercially launch AMT-130 for Huntington's disease; the $259M June 2026 raise was earmarked partly to fund launch readiness, but launch timing itself is not yet confirmed.

catalysts.label: Updated Phase I/IIa results for AMT-260
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to present updated results from the ongoing Phase I/IIa study of AMT-260 in refractory epilepsy, including data from the second dose cohort.

pulse: uniQure remains in a strong post-turnaround stretch: after the FDA agreed on June 17 that existing 3-year AMT-130 data can support an accelerated-approval BLA, the company closed a $259M raise (June 25) that pushed cash runway into 2030, reported encouraging early AMT-260 epilepsy data (June 19), and posted Q2 2026 results (July 29) that beat revenue estimates while reaffirming Q3 2026 US/UK filing plans and flagging a September 2026 four-year AMT-130 data readout as the next major catalyst. Analyst sentiment keeps improving, with Wells Fargo lifting its target to $75 on July 31, even as the net loss widens and some insiders continue to sell into the rally.
